description: Title chances: each league's likeliest champions from CrystlQuant's season forecasts, with the change since the last update and a link to the league's page. A row with no CrystlQuant number yet shows the CQ blind model's chance and says so. The limit is per league.

limit.description: How many rows to return per league (1-5, default 5).

sport.description: Optional. One sport: nfl = NFL, ncaaf = College football, nba = NBA, ncaab = College basketball, nhl = NHL, mlb = MLB, football = Football (soccer), f1 = F1, motogp = MOTOGP.

name: who_wins_it_all
title: Who wins it all
